We’re Glimberpay, a digital wallet business based in Leeds. We built the app around a familiar market-day muddle: buying something at several different stalls and then trying to remember which payment went with which purchase. At participating stalls, shoppers scan the trader’s QR code, check the payment details and pay from their topped-up wallet. Their payments stay together in the app, with the stall name attached, so the shopping trip is easier to make sense of afterwards.

Our customers are people who enjoy shopping at markets, whether that means a regular grocery trip or an occasional browse through independent stalls. We want the product to feel practical and approachable. Please keep our voice plain, lightly playful and specific about what the wallet does. Participation matters: we serve the United Kingdom, but we don’t claim that every market trader accepts Glimberpay. Our Leeds base is part of our story, rather than a limit on where customers can use the service.

The landing page is https://glimberpay.co.uk/market-wallet. Here’s the copy from our landing page: "Glimberpay is the Leeds-built digital wallet for scanning a QR code and paying at participating market stalls across the United Kingdom. Download free, top up your wallet and pay with no monthly wallet fee. Install by 9 July 2027 and get receipt sorting free for your first 30 days. Available only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones."

Receipt sorting groups the receipts from a market visit together, which is the little extra we’re offering with this push. The free period starts when someone installs and lasts 30 days; it then switches off without an automatic charge. The wallet itself remains free to download and has no monthly wallet fee. There’s no special occasion behind the campaign. We simply want more people to have the app ready for their next market visit. The product exists only for iPhone running iOS and Android phones; there isn’t a desktop or tablet version.

Please run the campaign from Sunday, June 27, 2027 through Friday, July 9, 2027, inclusive. That is 13 days in our account’s time zone, UK time, which is British Summer Time during this flight. Our objective is as many app installs as possible, and installs are what we count. A landing-page visit, an app-store click or an account registration is not the result we’re asking you to maximise.

Our site has X’s pixel, and our tracking reports each completed install to X under the event name "Wallet installed". Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the app stores from there, so there’s no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. Please use the supplied posts with that landing page as their destination.

X counts our advertising as financial services advertising. We hold the licences required for the service we provide in the United Kingdom, and X has approved our account for financial services ads in the United Kingdom. That approval is already in place.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please watch it throughout the full flight and make adjustments as needed to pursue more completed installs. At the end, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks, along with the number of installs reported through "Wallet installed" and a brief explanation of what worked.

Total budget: 400.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
